ai.title: AI assistant (optional)
ai.intro: GovSathi works fully without AI. If you want AI-written explanations of your results, you can connect your own account with an AI provider.
ai.cost: Your API key is your own credential. The provider may charge you for using it. GovSathi does not provide, share or pay for any key.
ai.storage: The key is kept in this browser only, for this session unless you choose to remember it on this device. It is sent over a secure connection with each search so that your chosen provider can answer. GovSathi does not store it or write it to logs. You can remove it at any time.
ai.remove: Remove key and turn off AI
ai.notConfigured: AI is off. Searching works without it.
ai.noModelList: This provider does not list models here. Type a model name from its documentation.

ai.error.unavailable: The provider could not be reached. Try again or choose another provider.
